title: Herbaceous Brazilian Sirloin Soup
description: A light, comforting soup brimming with aromatic herbs and tender sirloin steak tips, perfect for a quick yet satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Sirloin steak tips
ingredients.notes: cut into bite‑size pieces; optional for vegetarian version

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the steak tips and brown on all sides for about 4 minutes; remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add the diced onion, carrot, celery, and minced garlic; sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the dried oregano and thyme, cooking for 30 seconds to bloom the flavors.
Pour in the beef broth and vegetable broth, then add the bay leaf; bring to a gentle boil.
Return the browned steak to the pot, reduce heat to low, and let simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the chopped kale, simmer an additional 5 minutes until the greens are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste; remove the bay leaf.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
For a vegetarian version, omit the steak and add extra vegetables or a plant‑based protein if desired.
